name: Feather Lure
description: A feather tied on a fishing rod's line, so fish bite twice as often. A fishing rod and a feather make a Lured Fishing Rod, anywhere they fit, keeping the rod's wear. It wears as a fishing rod does, and each fish you catch has a 1 in 8 chance of taking the feather, leaving a plain fishing rod in your hand.
